newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq stocks dip as techs hit by earnings news.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq stocks dip as techs hit by earnings news.

text.p: Nasdaq stocks ended a string of three record closing highs on Wednesday after earnings news from a trio of companies hit technology stocks.

Traders said the day's tone was set by quarterly earnings from Oracle Corp that failed to meet more optimistic Wall Street forecasts, along with warnings from Seagate Technology Inc and Gateway 2000 Inc that their quarterly results will fall short of expectations.
"That put kind of a damper on the market," said Nelson Gold, senior vice president of over-the-counter trading at Interstate-Johnson Lane Corp.
The Nasdaq composite finished down about 11 points, or 0.74 percent, at 1432.
Among tech stocks, Oracle finished off 2-15/16 at 50-5/16, Intel Corp dropped 3-2/16 to 146-9/16 and Dell Computer Corp lost four to 116-7/8.

Bucking the trend, Jabil Circuit Inc jumped 13-3/8 to 82-1/4 after the company reported strong third quarter earnings, set a two-for-one stock split and had its rating raised by Robertson Stephens to buy from market performer.
